name: PT Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk
summary: PT Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk engages in the real estate and property development businesses in Indonesia. The company develops residential, commercial and tourism areas, including housing, land lots, and recreational facilities; and engages in construction activities. It also provides land lots to investors for private development of residential and commercial; full municipality services by township management; and maintenance of facilities and infrastructures services. PT Gowa Makassar Tourism Development Tbk was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Makassar, Indonesia.
